definition.def: If you say that something illustrates a situation that you are drawing attention to, you mean that it shows that the situation exists.
examples: The example of the United States illustrates this point. [VERB noun]
This change is neatly illustrated by what has happened to the Arab League. [VERB noun]
The incident graphically illustrates how parlous their position is. [VERB wh]
The case also illustrates that some women are now trying to fight back. [VERB that]

definition.def: If you use an example, story, or diagram to illustrate a point, you use it to show that what you are saying is true or to make your meaning clearer.
examples: Let me give another example to illustrate this difficult point. [VERB noun]
Throughout, she illustrates her analysis with excerpts from discussions. [VERB noun + with]

definition.def: If you illustrate a book, you put pictures, photographs, or diagrams into it.
examples: She went on to art school and is now illustrating a book. [VERB noun]
He has illustrated the book with black-and-white photographs. [VERB noun + with]
